challenge.method: Read the section 10.3 exception to test whether someone entitled to create a modified license thereby becomes another MPL steward.
challenge.results: Section 10.3 allows a renamed, modified license for software outside this license, subject to conditions on references to the steward. It qualifies the new-version rule and leaves the express designation of Mozilla Foundation intact.

limitations: The finding identifies the role assigned in MPL 2.0. It establishes no standalone permission to copy or redistribute the complete license document.
Section 2.1 addresses rights contributors grant in their contributions. It supplies no additional basis for the stewardship finding.
reasoning: Section 10.1, “New Versions,” expressly assigns the license steward role to Mozilla Foundation. Its following sentences describe authority over new versions and expressly qualify that authority by reference to section 10.3.
